V555-V557 then re-key through mediation/pressureflow/renderer contracts while retaining V553 harmonization evidence mainly as artifact-level authority context. V558 reads and revalidates the V557 renderer/readiness/audit bundle and normalizes runtime-governance fields; exact V551 atom, V550J respondent, V552 structural-fact, and V552J packet/join identities are not demonstrated direct V558 runtime-input semantic keys.
